# Pipedream

> > Pipedream is a developer-first workflow automation platform for connecting APIs, AI, databases, and SaaS applications with serverless orchestration.

Pipedream enables developers to build integrations and automations using code or no-code interfaces, featuring pre-built connectors for services like GitHub, Slack, Gmail, Google Sheets, and hundreds more. The platform supports OAuth authentication, AI agents, and custom API integrations through Pipedream Connect SDK.

## Key Topics

- Workflow Automation
- API Integration
- AI Agents
- Serverless Orchestration
- No-Code Automation
- Pipedream Connect
- OAuth Authentication
- Integration SDK
- Developer Platform
- GitHub
- Slack
- Gmail
- Google Sheets
- API Orchestration
